list.name: Backend API Layer
list.description: DRF ViewSets, serializers, and URL routers across all Django apps that together expose the 71-endpoint REST surface consumed by the web and mobile clients.

list.name: Backend Data Layer
list.description: Django ORM models, database migrations, and the custom UserManager that define the PostGIS-backed schema for users, labs, appointments, analyses, inventory, and notifications.

list.name: Backend Service Layer
list.description: Cross-cutting Django infrastructure providing permission classes, OTP and Firebase auth services, TOTP 2FA, JWT token generation, notification event dispatch, PDF report generation, Celery task configuration, Django app configs, admin registrations, management commands, and shared middleware utilities.

list.name: Web UI Layer
list.description: React 19 + Vite web dashboard presenting the staff-facing interface with role-aware screens for dashboard, analyses, inventory, nurses map, staff management, statistics, and settings, built on shared components, hooks, and a centralized API and auth context.

list.name: Mobile UI Layer

list.name: Infrastructure Layer
list.description: Container and deployment definitions for the labConnect platform, including the Django backend Dockerfile, Docker Compose database service, Render.com deployment blueprints, and the Docker build-context exclusion list.

list.name: Documentation and Configuration
list.description: Project-level API reference, developer setup guides, Python dependency manifest, and tooling configuration files that support development workflow without being part of any runnable application layer.
